text:
Type: clear glass hourglass vase
Use: holding fresh flowers or branches on a dining table, sideboard, shelf or coffee table; dining room, living room
Style: minimalist, classic, Scandinavian
Materials: clear transparent glass, thick heavy base
Colors: clear glass
Shape: waisted hourglass silhouette with a narrow middle, wide flared mouth, rounded foot, tall and simple, transparent and airy
Feel: fresh, light, elegant, timeless
Goes with: fresh flowers, green stems, wood or stone surfaces, white walls; minimalist, classic or Scandinavian rooms
